title: Assess Dify through a bounded evidence-first pilot
summary: Turn pinned public repository evidence into a conditional pilot route without treating documentation as runtime, security, operational, or license proof.
applicability: A team is evaluating Dify as a self-hosted platform for LLM workflows and retrieval applications.
The first decision can be based on public evidence while runtime work remains separately gated.
problem: Source documentation can establish candidate relevance but cannot by itself justify adoption or production deployment.
intendedOutcomes: A reproducible candidate-fit assessment pinned to immutable public evidence.
An explicit list of license, runtime, operations, and security gates.
A bounded pilot recommendation that requires separate authorization before execution.
exclusions: Legal advice or a license compatibility determination.
A claim that Dify is secure, performant, or production-ready.
Execution of Dify code, containers, migrations, or plugins as part of the evidence-only assessment.

evidence.title: Pinned Dify main revision observation
limitations: The observation records a branch head at one time; all file links remain commit-pinned.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata observation
limitations: Public visibility does not determine license compatibility or runtime fitness.
The embedded observation is reproducible, but live repository metadata can change after the observation time.

evidence.title: Dify README at pinned revision
limitations: Upstream feature and resource statements are not observed runtime results.

evidence.title: Dify modified license at pinned revision
limitations: Technical license evidence is not legal advice and requires qualified human review for the intended use.

evidence.title: Dify security policy at pinned revision
limitations: A disclosure policy is not evidence that a release or deployment is secure.

evidence.title: Dify Docker Compose manifest at pinned revision
limitations: The manifest was inspected as text and was not applied.

evidence.title: Dify Docker deployment guide at pinned revision
limitations: Documented deployment procedures were not executed.

evidence.title: AtlasRepo Dify evidence manifest
limitations: The manifest contains source observations and does not contain runtime evidence.

evidence.title: AtlasRepo Dify source observations
limitations: The observations are a bounded source review, not runtime, security, or legal proof.

claims.statement: Dify is documented as covering the relevant workflow, retrieval, agent, model, observability, and API capabilities and provides a Compose self-hosting path.
limitations: The claim describes pinned documentation and not observed behavior.

claims.statement: The current evidence supports only a bounded local pilot after qualified license review, with adoption and deployment still blocked.
limitations: The recommendation does not authorize execution and does not establish production fitness.

inputs.name: targetUse
inputs.description: The intended tenancy, branding, distribution, integrations, and operational environment.

inputs.name: resourceBudget
inputs.description: CPU, memory, storage, time, and cost bounds for a future local pilot.

outputs.name: decisionPack
outputs.description: A proof-backed recommended, conditional, or abstained decision with exact evidence citations and unresolved gates.

steps.title: Inspect immutable public sources
steps.instruction: Verify the pinned revision and source-file SHA-256 digests without executing repository code.

executionPolicy.recovery: Discard the fetched metadata and retain the previously verified pin.

steps.title: Review the modified license
steps.instruction: Have a qualified human assess the pinned license against the exact tenancy, branding, and distribution model; record the conclusion as new evidence.

executionPolicy.recovery: Record the failed review gate without changing the source or decision.

steps.title: Run a separately authorized local pilot
steps.instruction: Only after license clearance, run Dify in an isolated local sandbox with explicit resource limits and collect startup, health, resource, integration, and teardown evidence.

executionPolicy.recovery: Stop and remove only resources created under the explicit local pilot identity.

steps.title: Review security and operations
steps.instruction: Assess the selected configuration for threats, secrets, observability, backup, restore, upgrade, rollback, and incident recovery using independent evidence.

executionPolicy.recovery: Keep the prior decision status and attach the incomplete verification evidence.

steps.title: Issue an evidence-bounded decision
steps.instruction: Compose a decision pack. Keep status conditional while any required gate remains unresolved and abstain if a required gate fails.

executionPolicy.recovery: Preserve the previous conditional decision and report the failed readiness check.

checks.description: Pinned source bytes match the recorded digests.
evidenceRequirements: SHA-256 results for each cited source file

checks.description: The modified license is reviewed against the exact intended use.
evidenceRequirements: Qualified human conclusion scoped to tenancy, branding, and distribution

checks.description: The selected release starts and operates inside the bounded target environment.
The team can operate and recover the selected configuration.
A threat-informed review covers the selected release and configuration.

readinessCriteria.description: All source evidence is immutable and digest-verified.
Qualified review permits the exact intended use.
A bounded pilot produces acceptable runtime and resource evidence.
Backup, restore, observability, upgrade, rollback, and ownership are demonstrated.
The selected release and configuration pass an independent security review with accepted residual risk.
